sa: मयि जीवति राज्यं कः सम्प्रशासेत् पुमानिह। मावमंस्था वचो मां शममिच्छामि वः सदा॥
en: When I am alive what other man can rule over this kingdom? Do not treat slightingly my words for we ever wish peace.

sa: कुण्डले मे प्रयच्छस्व वर्म चैव शरीरजम्। गृहाण कर्ण शक्तिं त्वमनेन समयेन च॥
en: Bestow on me your ear-rings and the armour born with your body and (then) O Karna, take the dart under the (following) condition.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्त्वा प्रारुदत् कृष्णा भीमस्योर:समाश्रिता। भीमश्च तां परिष्वज्य महत् सान्त्वं प्रयुज्य च॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said this, Krishna, lying on the breast of Bhima, began to weep. Having clasped her, Bhima also afforded her a great consolation.

sa: शिरः पशोस्ते दास्यस्ति भागं यज्ञेषु मानवाः। एष तेऽनुग्रहस्तक्षन् क्षिप्रं कुरु मम प्रियम्॥
en: In sacrificial rites, men will give the heads of the beasts. This is the favour I great you. Quickly do what I desire.

sa: येन वेदानधीते स्म पिबते सोममेव च। तस्माद् वक्त्राद् विनिश्चेरुः क्षिप्रं तस्य कपिञ्जलाः॥४०
en: From the mouth by which he used to read the Veda and drink Soma juice, came forth quickly birds of the Kapinjala species,

sa: क्लेशितश्च वने शूरो वासवेनापि शिक्षितः। अमर्षवशमापन्नो वासवप्रतिमो युधि। नेहास्य प्रतियोद्धारमहं पश्यामि कौरवाः॥
en: The hero suffered hardships in the forest and was instructed by Indra. Indignant (as he is) he is equal to Vasava in battle.

sa: गुणवन्ति च धान्यानि रसवन्ति फलानि च। गन्धवन्ति च माल्यानि शुभशब्दा च भारती॥
en: There the paddy is full of grain and the fruits are juicy-the garlands are fragrant and the conversation is full of auspicious words.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्तस्याः करौ सूक्ष्मौ किणबद्धौ वृकोदरः। मुखमानीय वै पल्या रुरोद परवीरहा॥
en: Then Vrikodara the slayer of hostile heroes, covering his face with the delicate hands of his wife, marked with scars, began to weep.

sa: नारद उवाच ऋषभस्य ततः शृङ्गं निपत्य द्विजपक्षिणौ। शाण्डिली ब्राह्मणी तत्र ददृशाते तपोऽन्विताम्॥
en: Narada said Then having alighted on the peak of the Rishava mountain, the two saw there a Brahmani named Shandili, endued with asceticism.

sa: उत्थानं संयमो दाक्ष्यमप्रमादो धृतिः स्मृतिः। समीक्ष्य च समारम्भो विद्धि मूलं भवस्य तु॥
en: Energy, self-control, skillfulness steadiness, patience and the act of beginning a thing after mature thought, know these to be the roots of prosperity.

sa: या न जातु स्वयं पिंपे गात्रोद्वर्तनमात्मनः। अन्यत्र कुन्त्या भद्रं ते सा पिनष्यद्य चन्दनम्॥
en: Even she, who had never pounded unguents for herself except for Kunti, has been now pounding the sandal (for others) O! let good betide you.

sa: तथा ब्रुवन्तं धर्मात्मा प्राह राजा युधिष्ठिरः। तव धैर्यं च वीर्यं पाञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सह॥
en: King Yudhishthira of a virtuous soul said to him who was thus speaking-'The Panchalas along with the Pandavas all depend on your wisdom and prowess.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथाऽऽसीनेषु सर्वेषु तेषु राजसु भारत। यदुक्तं कृष्णया सार्धं तत् सर्वं प्रत्यवेदयत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said: O descendant of Bharata, when all those princes were seated at rest, he related to them the conversation that he had with Krishna.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच एवमुक्ते तु भीष्मेण द्रोणेन विदुरेण च। गान्धार्या धृतराष्ट्रेण न वै मन्दोऽन्वबुद्ध्यत॥
en: Vasudeva said Though thus spoken to by Bhishma and Drona and Vidura and Gandhari and Dhritarashtra, the fool was yet not brought to his senses.

sa: अविन्ध्यो नाम मेधावी वृद्धो राक्षसपुङ्गवः। स रामस्य हितान्वेषी त्वदर्थे हि स मावदत्॥
en: There is an old and intelligent Rakshasas chief named Avindhya. He seeks Rama's welfare and for your sake has told me (these words).

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्त्वा प्राद्रवत् कृष्णा सुदेष्णाया निवेशनम्। केशान् मुक्त्वा च सुश्रोणी संरम्भाल्लोहितेक्षणा।।४६
en: Vaishampayana said Having said this the fair Krishna with loosened hair and eyes reddened with wrath, rushed on towards the apartments of Sudeshna.

sa: क्व नु तेषाममर्षश्च वीर्य तेजश्च वर्तते। न परीप्सन्ति ये भार्यां वध्यमानां दुरात्मना॥
en: Ah, where is their wrath, the prowess and the energy when they cannot protect their wife from being thus insulted by a wretch.

sa: तद् दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्यं नरा नार्यश्च संगताः। विस्मयं परमं गत्वा नोचुः किञ्चन भारत॥
en: Beholding that wonderful deed men and women assembled; O descendant of Bharata, they were filled with surprise and could not speak any thing.

sa: तस्या स्मरन्ती वचनमाशंसे विजयं तव। तस्मात् तात व्रवीमि त्वां वक्ष्यामि च पुनः पुनः॥
en: Remembering these words I expect your victory, therefore do I speak this to you, my dear son, and am telling you this again and again.

sa: सत्येन रक्ष्यते धर्मो विद्या योगेन रक्ष्यते। मृजया रक्ष्यते रूपं कुलं वृत्तेन रक्ष्यते॥
en: Virtue is preserved by truthfulness; learning is preserved by exercise; beauty is preserved by toilet; and noble birth is preserved by good manners.

sa: पित्र्यमंशं महाबाहो निमग्नं पुनरुद्धर। साम्ना भेदेन दानेन दण्डेनाथ नयेन वा॥ । नु
en: O you of long arms, earn again your paternal wealth which is lost, by means of conciliation, dispute, gifts, punishment, or by diplomacy.

sa: सन्ति बयस्तव प्रेष्या राजपुत्रि वशानुगाः। अन्यां प्रेषय भद्रं ते स हि मामवमंस्यते॥
en: O princess, you have good many obedient maids, pray send one of them. Let good betide you, for surely he will insult me.

sa: श्वशुरावूचतुः व्रतं यथोपदिष्टं तु तथा तत् पारितं त्वया। आहारकालः सम्प्राप्तः क्रियतां यदनन्तरम्॥
en: The Father-in-law said : You have performed the vow as directed. It is now the time to eat. Do what you think proper.

sa: सा बान्धवभयाद् बाला गर्भं तं विनिगूहती। धारयामास सुश्रोणी न चैनां बुबुधे जनः॥
en: That fair-hipped damsel afraid of the censure of her friends concealed her pregnancy, so that no body was aware of her real state.

sa: निहते तु ततो वृत्रे दिशो वितिमिराऽभवन्। प्रववौ च शिवो वायुः प्रजाश्च जहषुस्तथा॥
en: And Vritra being slain, the cardinal points became divested of darkness and a pleasant wind blew and the beings of the earth rejoiced.

sa: पुरं तद् भुवि विख्यातं नाम्ना भोजकटं नृप। स भोजराजः सैन्येन महता परिवारितः॥
en: That city became famous by the name of Bhojakata, O ruler of men. That king of the Bhojas surrounded by a large army,

sa: पुत्रा गन्धर्वराजस्य महासत्त्वस्य कस्यचित्। रक्षन्ति ते च मां नित्यं दुःखाचारा तथा ह्यहम्॥
en: They are the sons of certain Gandharva king of extra-ordinary strength; they always protect me. Also my mode of living is very hard.

sa: अवशोऽहं तदा तात पुत्राणां निहते शते। श्रोष्यामि निनदं स्त्रीणां कथं मां मरणं स्पृशेत्॥
en: I shall be helpless, O dear, on my hundred sons being killed and shall hear the loud lamentation of women. How shall death touch me?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं ब्रुवति राजेन्द्रे कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। अन्वशासत् स संयोगं समये मत्स्यपार्थयोः॥
en: Vaishampayana said After the king had said this, Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, gave his assent to the alliance between Matsya and Partha.

sa: धुमत्सेन उवाच व्रतं भिन्धीति वक्तुं त्वां नास्मि शक्तः कथञ्चन। पारयस्येति वचनं युक्तमस्मद्विधो वदेत्॥
en: Dyumatsena said : I can, by no means tell you to give up your vow. Men like us should rather encourage you to complete it.

sa: प्राग्ज्योतिषगतं शौरि नरकः सह दानवैः। ग्रहीतुं नाशकत् तत्र तं त्वं प्रार्थयसे बलात्॥
en: Naraka, along with all the Danavas, could not capture Shouri who had gone to Pragjyotisha and you want to capture him by force.

sa: यत् त्वया कथितं पूर्व मामनासाद्य किंचना तदद्य कुरु राधेय कुरुमध्ये मया सह॥
en: Fighting with me today in the midst of the Kurus, do you make good the insulting words that you used towards me before.

sa: दिवा रात्रौ च भात्येष सुतेजा विमलो मणिः। तमप्यस्मै प्रदास्यामि तमर्हति हि केशवः॥
en: I shall give him this pure and very bright gem that shines day and night; for Keshava is the proper recipient of these.

sa: न शशाक यदा बाला प्रत्याख्यातुं तमोनुदम्। भीता शापात् ततो राजन् दध्यौ दीर्घमथान्तरम्॥
en: And when all the entreaties of that maiden to the dispeller of darkness were unavailing, afraid of her curse she long meditated thus

sa: अनिन्धं निन्दते यो हि अप्रशंस्यं प्रशंसति। स पश्यतु बलं मेऽद्य आत्मानं तु विगर्हतु॥
en: He abuses those that do not deserve it and praises those that should not be praised. Let hiin today see my prowess and blame himself.

sa: कौमारं व्रतमास्थाय त्रिदिवं पावितं त्वया।॥ तेन त्वं स्तूयसे देवि त्रिदशैः पूज्यसेऽपि च।
en: Having accepted the vow of maiden hood you have sanctified the heaven; therefore, O goddess, you are praised and adorned by the gods.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो विमुच्य बाहुभ्यां वलयानि स वीर्यवान्। चित्रे काञ्चनसंनाहे प्रत्यमुञ्चत् तदा तले॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then taking off from his arms the bracelets, the powerful (Arjuna) put on his hands a pair of beautiful gloves embroidered with gold.

sa: य इदं दारुणाकारं न जानीषे महाभयम्। एष तीर्वार्णवं रामः सेतुना हरिभिः सह॥ अवमन्येह नः सर्वान् करोति कदनं महत्। मया त्वपहृता भार्या सीता नामास्य जानकी॥
en: Unaware of this dreadful calamity (we have been visited with). This Rama together with the monkeys having crossed the sea by means of a bridge and disregarding us all is waging a terrible war. I have stealthily abducted his wife, named Sita, the daughter of Janaka.

sa: नैष कामयते धर्म नैष कामयते यशः। जितं स मन्यते सर्वं दुरात्मा कर्णमाश्रितः॥
en: He does not seek virtue, nor does he see renown, under the protection of Karna, that evil souled one considers everything as conquered.

sa: न चैषा देहभेदेन हता स्यादिति मे मतिः। जहि भर्तारमेवास्याहते तस्मिन् हता भवेत्॥
en: In my opinion, she would not be killed if her body were destroyed. Kill her husband and then she will be killed too.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सा शोकार्ता च हृष्टा च दृष्ट्वा गोविन्दमागतम्। नानाविधानि दुःखानि सर्वाण्येवान्वकीर्तयत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said That lady oppressed with sorrow and yet cheerful seeing Govinda come, began to describe all the diverse grief's she had suffered.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच उक्तं भगवता वाक्यमुक्तं भीष्मेण यत् क्षयम्। उक्तं बहुविधं चैव नारदेनापि तच्छृणु॥
en: Vaishampayana said Words were spoken by Krishna and Bhishma, all that could be said and many were the words spoken by Narada. Listen to them.

sa: सुधन्वोवाच पितापुत्रौ सहासीतां द्वौ विप्रौ क्षत्रियावपि। वृद्धौ वैश्यौ च शूद्रौ च न त्वन्यावितरेतरम्॥
en: Sudhanvan said Father and son, two Brahmanas, two Kshatriyas, two old men and two Sudras can sit together. Excepting these, no others can sit together.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच एवमुक्त्वा स धर्मात्मा गुरुभक्तो गुरुप्रियः॥ उच्छ्रित्य बाहू दुःखार्तः सुस्वरं प्ररुरोद ह।
en: Markandeya said : Saying this, that virtuous one devoted to and fond of his parents, raising his arms began to bewail loudly in great sorrow.

sa: शल्य उवाच क्रुद्धं तु नहुषं दृष्ट्वा देवा ऋषिपुरोगमाः। अब्रुवन् देवराजानां नहुषं घोरदर्शनम्॥
en: Shalya said The gods and the foremost among the Rishis seeing Nahusha enraged said to the (now) terrible looking king of the gods.

sa: ध्रुवं तथा तद् भविता जानीमस्तस्य निश्चयम्। तेन हर्षः प्रणष्टो मे सुपर्णवचनेन वै॥
en: It will surely happen so for I know his determination and for this reason is my cheerfulness lost by the words Suparna (Garuda)."

sa: भीष्मे द्रोणे कृपे कर्णे द्रोणपुत्रे जयद्रथे। भूयसी वर्तते वृत्तिं न शमे कुरुते मनः॥
en: He has too great a confidence on Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, Karna, the son of Drona and Jayadratha and therefore he does not think of peace.

sa: सुहृदां हितकामानां न श्रुतं वचनं त्वया । भ्रातृणां चैव कात्स्न्येन हितमुक्तं दशानन।।७६
en: O Ten-necked one, you did not hear the words of your friends and brothers, who spoke those well meaning words out of affection.

sa: किं करिष्याम्यहं तेन शक्रतुल्यबलेन हि। ईदृशे व्यसने घोरे यो न साह्याय कल्पते॥
en: If he does not help me in such high peril, what shall I do with his strength resembling the strength of Sakra himself?

sa: अग्रतः कुरु शीघ्रं दाशरथे: शिरः। अवस्था पश्चिमां भर्तुः कृपणां साधु पश्यतु ॥
en: Do you at once hold before Sītā the head of Dasaratha's son. Let her clearly behold the ultimate sad plight of her lord.

sa: श्रोष्यते चैव काकुत्स्थः सर्वं निरवशेषतः। चेष्टितं यत् त्वया देवि भाषितं च ममाग्रतः॥
en: Truly shall Kākutstha hear from the beginning to the end, O worshipful dame, of your actions before me, and all you had said.

sa: अथ चिन्तयतस्तस्य स एव पुरुषोऽब्रवीत्॥ किं त्वं चिन्तयसे रक्षो ब्रूहि विस्रब्धमानसः। युद्धातिथ्यमहं वीर करिष्ये रजनीचर॥ एवमुक्त्वा स तद्रक्षः पुनर्वचनमब्रवीत्। योत्स्यसे बलिना सार्धमथवा मन्यसे कथम्॥ रावणोऽभिहितो भूय ऊर्ध्वरोमा व्यजायत। अथ धैर्य समालम्ब्य रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥ गृहेषु तिष्ठते को हि तद्रूहि वदतां वर। तेनैव सार्धं योत्स्यामि यथा वा मन्यते भवान्॥ स एनं पुनरप्याह दानवेन्द्रोऽत्र तिष्ठति।
en: He thus meditating that man said, 'What are you thinking, O Raksasa? Tell me all in confidence. I shall confer upon you the hospitality of fighting, O hero, O night-ranger.' Having said this he again spoke to Ravana, saying, 'Do you wish to enter into conflict with Bali, or what else is your intention?' Răvaņa was so overwhelmed that his hair stood on their end; but resorting to calmness he said, 'O you foremost of those skilled in speech, who resident in this house? I shall fight with him; speak out what you wish.' He again said (to Ravana) Ocean

sa: मम हेतोः पराक्रान्ता ये गता यमसादनम्। ते सर्वे जीवितं प्राप्य समुत्तिष्ठन्तु वानराः॥
en: Let all these highly powerful monkeys, who have been despatched to the abode of Death, on my account, regaining their life, stand up.

sa: देवि नेह भयं कार्यं मयि विश्वसिहि प्रिये। प्रणयस्व च तत्त्वेन मैवं भूः शोकलालसा॥
en: Do not fear me, O worshipful damsel, confide in me O my beloved one, and become attached to me. Do not give way to grief.

sa: क्व ते रामेण संसर्गः कथं जानासि लक्ष्मणम्। वानराणां नराणां च कथमासीत् समागमः॥
en: Where didst you meet Rāma, how didst you come to know Lakşmaņa? How did the monkeys and men meet on terms of brother-hood?

sa: एवं बलिभ्यो बलिनः सन्ति राघवनन्दन । नावज्ञा हि परे कार्या य इच्छेच्छेय आत्मनः॥
en: Observe therefore, O descendant of Raghu, there is a mightier man than the mighty; therefore, one, desirous of his own well-being, should not disregard another.

sa: संशये स्थाप्य मां चेदं बलं चेमं बिभीषणम्। कष्टं कृतमिदं वीर साहसं साहसप्रिय॥
en: Placing in suspense, me, this army and Vibhīş aņa, you, O hero, enamoured of daring deeds, have put yourself to all this trouble.

sa: कथं जनकराजस्य दुहिता मम च प्रिया। राक्षसीमध्यगा शेते स्नुषा दशरथस्य च ॥
en: How fare in the midst of the shc-demons, that daughter of the king Janaka, my beloved spouse, and the daughter-in-law of king Dasaratha?

sa: निर्दहेच्च पुरीं लङ्कां निर्दहेच्च महोदधिम्। रावणस्य च नीचस्य कीर्तिं नाम च नाशयेत्॥
en: He would have then burnt down the city of Lankā, dried up the deep and blotted out the name and fame of Rāvana.

sa: नैव वाचा न मनसा नैव बुद्ध्या न चक्षुषा। सुवृत्ता वृत्तशौटीर्यं न त्वामत्यचरच्छुभा॥
en: Neither by words, mind, understanding nor eyes, she, good-natured and beautiful-has deviated from you who has got a good character and is heroic.

sa: सीतां तु मोहितां दृष्ट्वा सरमा नाम राक्षसी। आससादाथ वैदेहीं प्रियां प्रणयिनी सखी॥
en: Seeing Sītā overwhelmed with grief, a Rākşasi, named Saramā, who was the beloved companion (of Sītā), drew near to his dear (friend), Vaidehi.

sa: अद्येह व्यसनं प्राप्तं यन्मां परुषमुक्तवान्। प्रवेष्टुं न त्वया शक्यं न्यग्रोधं राक्षसाधम ॥
en: To-day you have addressed harshly me, who have fallen on evil days; but, O worst of Raks asas, you cannot pass this Nyagrodha.

sa: स त्वमस्मद्धितार्थाय जहि तान्मधुसूदन । शरणं त्वां वयं प्राप्ता गतिर्भव सुरेश्वर ॥
en: Do you, O slayer of Madhu, destroy them for our welfare. We have sought your shelter. Become our refuge, O foremost of celestials.

sa: यस्य त्वेतानि चत्वारि वानरेन्द्र यथा तव। धृतिर्दृष्टिर्मतिर्दाक्ष्य स कर्मसु न सीदति ॥
en: He, O chief of monkeys, that, like you, is endowed with endurance, sharp sightedness, sense, and ability, dose not feel depressed in action.

sa: आशंसेयं हरिश्रेष्ठ क्षिप्रं मां प्राप्स्यते पतिः। अन्तरात्मा हि मे शुद्धस्तस्मिंश्च बहवो गुणाः॥
en: I hope, O foremost of monkeys, that my husband shall soon regain me for pure soul and he is gifted with many accomplishments.

sa: तयोः शरपथं प्राप्य रावणो राजपुत्रयोः। स बभौ च यथा राहुः समीपे शशिसूर्ययोः॥
en: Coming within the range of the arrows of those two Princes, Rāvaņa appeared like Rahu in presence of the sun and the moon.

sa: आयान्तं स रथं दृष्ट्वा तूर्णमिन्द्रध्वजं कपिः। ननाद च महानादं व्यवर्धत च वेगवान्॥
en: Beholding that car having a flag like that of Indra, approach very quickly, the monkey began to emit terrible roars and increase himself.

sa: विकत्थनानि वो यानि भवद्भिर्जनसंसदि। तानि वः क्व नु यातानि सोदग्राणि हतानि च॥
en: Where now is gone that talk of your anent your nobility and the welfare (of your king) which you had held in society.

sa: चलत्केसरमात्मानं कृत्वा तस्य तटे स्थितः। ददर्श तस्मिन्सरसि वक्रच्छायामथात्मनः॥ कोऽयमस्मिन्मम रिपुर्वसत्यन्त ले महान्। रूपं चान्तर्गतं तत्र वीक्ष्य तत्पश्यतो हरिः॥ क्रोधाविष्टमना होष नियतं मावमन्यते। तदस्य दुष्टभावस्य पुष्कलं कुमतेहम्॥ एवं स चिन्त्य मनसा स वै वानरचापलात्। आप्लुत्य चापतत्तस्मिन्हदे वानरसत्तमः॥ उत्प्लुत्य तस्मात्स ह्रदादुत्थितः प्लवगः पुनः। तस्मिन्नेव क्षणे राम स्त्रीत्वं प्राप स वानरः॥ मनोज्ञरूपा सा नारी लावण्यललिता शुभा। विस्तीर्णजघना सुधूर्नीलकुन्तलमूर्धजा॥ मुग्धसस्मितवक्रा च पी
en: Having shaken his manes with a delighted heart, Rkşarāja saw his reflection in his waters. Beholding his own image there that monkey-chief, stricken with anger and anxiety thought-“What arch-enemy of mine is living in the waters? I shall destroy the excellent abode of the vicious-souled one.” Thinking thus within himself, that monkey, out of fickleness, jumped down into the lake. And he again sprang up therefrom. And at the time of rising, O Rama, that leading monkey found himself-metamorphosed into a female form, which was highly charming, graceful and beautiful. Her waist was spacious, eye-brows beautiful and hairs were black and curling; her countenance was beautiful and smiling, breast high and beauty matchless.

sa: रावणं समरे हत्वा न चिरादेव मैथिलि। त्वया समग्रः प्रियया सुखार्हो लप्स्यते सुखम्।३३।।
en: O Mithila's daughter, speedily slaying Ravana in battle, that one worthy of happiness shall reap felicity in the company of you, his beloved.

sa: जितं हि भवता सर्व त्रैलोक्यं स्वेन तेजसा। कृता प्रतिज्ञा सफला प्रीतोऽस्मि ससुतस्य ते।४॥
en: You have, by your own prowess, conquered the three worlds — your promise has borne fruits-I have been pleased with you-both the father and son.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजा मेघनादं प्रजापतिः। नास्ति सर्वामरत्वं हि कस्यचित्प्राणिनो भुवि॥ पक्षिणश्चतुष्पदो वा भूतानां वा महौजसाम्।
en: Thereat the highly powerful patriarch said to Meghanāda, “There is none perfectly immortal on earth among created beings, birds, quadrupeds and other highly powerful beings.”

sa: अहं यद्यहरं भायाँ राजपुत्रस्य धीमतः। किं तत्र तव सुग्रीव किष्किन्धां प्रति गम्यताम्॥
en: Though I have stolen the spouse of the highsouled prince (Räma), yet what is that to you, Sugriva? Do you return to Kiskindhā.

sa: नय मामपि तं देशं यत्र दृष्टा मम प्रिया। न तिष्ठेयं क्षणमपि प्रवृत्तिमुपलभ्य च॥
en: Do you take me there where you had beheld iny dear spouse. I cannot live for a moment while I have received intelligence about her.

sa: ततस्तु नीलः प्रतिलब्धसंज्ञः शैलं समुत्पाट्य सवृक्षखण्डम्। ततः समुत्पत्य महोग्रवेगो महोदरं तेन जघान मूर्ध्निः॥
en: Then that (monkey) possessed of tremendous vehemence, having regained his senses, uprooting a crag with a whole tract of trees, struck it at Mahodara's head.

sa: साधु ते तत्त्वतो देवी कथितं साधु भामिनि। गृहाण सुस्मिते वाक्यमन्यथा न भविष्यसि ॥
en: O damsel, O worshipful dame, we have spoken thus for your welfare. Do you comply with our request or you shall surely die. CECTION 24

sa: सुतः किल स शक्रस्य वायसः पततां वरः। धरान्तरगतः शीघ्रं पवनस्य गतौ समः॥
en: That crow, the best of the birds, was Sakra's son. And it entered speedily into the earth with the velocity of the wind,

sa: स उवाच महाप्राज्ञः स्वरेण महता महान्। सुग्रीवं तांश्च संप्रेक्ष्य स्वस्थ एव विभीषणः॥
en: And beholdings Sugrīva and all others stationed near him, the highly intelligent Vibhīşaņa accosted them, at the highest pitch of his voice, saying.

sa: अद्य मद्वाणवेगेन प्रेतराविषयं गतः। ये त्वया निहताः शूराः सह तैश्च वसिष्यसि ॥
en: Being despatched by my arrows to the world of devils, you shall live with those heroes, who had been killed by you before.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य विक्रमं प्लवगर्षभः। प्रगृह्य विपुलं शैलं चिक्षेप च ननाद च॥
en: Seeing that feat of Vajradanșra, that foremost of monkeys taking up a huge crag, hurled it (at his foe) and sent up shouts.

sa: ततो हतांस्तान्सहसा निशम्य राजा महाबाष्पपरिप्लुताक्षः। पुत्रक्षयं भ्रातृवधं च घोरं विचिन्त्य राजा विपुलं प्रदध्यौ॥
en: Suddenly hearing them slain, the king with his eyes charged with brine, thinking of the disastrous destruction of his sons and brothers, was extremely agonized.

sa: इत्येवं बाधमानस्तु पार्थिवान्पार्थिवर्षभ। चचार रावणो राम पृथिवीं पृथिवीपते॥ ततो माहिष्मती नाम पुरीं स्वर्गपुरीप्रभाम्। संप्राप्तो यत्र सांनिध्यं सदासीद्वसुरेतसः॥ तुल्य आसीन्नृपस्तस्य प्रभावाद्वसुरेतसः। अर्जुनो नाम यत्राग्निः शरकुण्डेशयः सदा॥
en: O Rāma, O lord of earth, traversing the earth, Rāvana arrived at the city of Māhismatī, resembling the city of the celestials, where lived perpetually the deity of fire. There reigned a king named Arjuna, effulgent like fire which was kept perpetually in a well covered with Sara.

sa: यत्कृते च वयं लङ्कां त्यक्त्वा याता रसातलम्। तद्गतं नो महाबाहो महद्विष्णुकृतं भयम्॥
en: O mighty-armed one, that great fear arising from Vişnu, from which leaving Larkā, we had gone to the nethermost abysses, has been removed.

sa: निहतो रावणो राम प्रहृष्टो दिवमाक्रम। अमोघं देव वीर्य ते न ते मोघाः पराक्रमाः॥
en: O Rāma, Răvaşa has been slain. Do you go up to heaven delighted. Sure is your godly energy and never goes for nothing your prowess.

sa: त्रिषु लोकेषु रत्नानि भुङ्क्ते आहृत्य रावणः। विक्रमे च बले चैव नास्त्यस्य सदृशो भुवि॥
en: Procuring gems from the three worlds, Răvana enjoy them. Neither in strength nor in prowess is there and one on earth who is his compeer.

sa: अहं लङ्कापतिर्भद्रे दशग्रीव इति श्रुतः। तस्य मे भव भार्या त्वं भुव भोगान्यथासुखम्।।२२।
en: I am the lord of Lărkā., O gentle lady. known as Dasagriva. Be you my wife, and enjoy pleasures according to your desire.

sa: ततस्तैर्वानरश्रेष्ठैरानीतं प्रेक्ष्य तज्जलम्। ५७।। अभिषेकाय रामस्य शत्रुघ्नः सचिवैः सह। पुरोहिताय श्रेष्ठाय सुहद्भयश्च न्यवेदयत्।५८॥
en: Beholding water thus brought by the leading monkeys for the installation of Rāma, Satrughna, with his ministers, communicated that to the leading priests and friends.

sa: तां तु भिन्नां शिलां दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवः क्रोधमुर्छितः। सालमुत्पाट्य चिक्षेप तं स चिच्छेद नैकधा॥ शरैश्च विददारैनं शूरः परबलार्दनः। स ददर्श ततः क्रुद्धः परिषं पतितं भुवि॥
en: Beholding that crag thus severed, Sugrīva was beside himself with ire; and uplifting a Sála tree hurled it; and the heroic Räkşasa the slayer of enemy's force, severed it into several pieces with his arrows. Thereupon excited with wrath he saw a parigha on the ground.

sa: वधार्थ रावणस्येह प्रविष्टो मानुषीं तनुम्। तदिदं नस्त्वया कार्यं कृतं धर्मभृतां वर ॥
en: For Rāvana's destruction you have assumed the human shape. You have accomplished that work of ours, O you the foremost of the pious.

sa: ब्रूहि यद् राघवो वाच्यो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः। सुग्रीवो वापि तेजस्वी हरयो वा समागताः॥
en: Now tell me what I shall communicate to Rāghava, and the highly powerful Lakşmaņa, and the energetic Sugrīva, and all the assembled monkeys.

sa: समागम्य सदा लोके यथायुद्धं प्रवर्तितम्। एवमुक्त्वा शितैर्बाणैस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणैः। आजघान रणे रामो दशग्रीवं समाहितः।५७।।
en: Having delivered himself thus, Rama, concentrating his attention, began to charge the Ten-necked one in encounter with whetted arrows decked with burnished gold.

sa: अहमाख्यामि ते राजश्रूयतां सर्वमेव तत्। यज्ञास्ते सप्त पुत्रेण प्राप्तास्ते बहुविस्तराः।७।। अग्निष्टोमोऽश्वमेधश्च यज्ञो बहुसुवर्णकः। राजसूयस्तथा यज्ञो गोमेधो वैष्णवस्तथा।।।। माहेश्वरे प्रवृत्ते तु यज्ञे पुंभिः सुदुर्लभे। वरांस्ते लब्धवान्पुत्रः साक्षात्पशुपतेरिह॥
en: Hear, I shall relate to you everything, O king; your son has met with the fruits of many a sacrifice, Agnistoma, Asvamedha, Bahusuvarņaka, Rājsūya, Gomedha and Vaisnava. And being engaged in this Maheśvara sacrifice, which is incapable of being celebrated by men, your son has obtained boon from Pasupati’ himself.

sa: कामं दृष्टा मया सर्वा विश्वस्ता रावणस्त्रियः। न तु मे मनसा किंचिद् वैकृत्यमुपपद्यते॥
en: All these unsuspecting wives of Rāvana have been beheld by me; yet there are no signs that my mind has undergone any alteration.

sa: मुश्च रामाद्भयं घोरं निहनिष्यामि संयुगे॥ राघवं लक्ष्मणं चैव सुग्रीवं च महाबलम्। हनूमन्तं च रक्षोघ्नं येन लङ्का प्रदीपिता॥ हरीश्च भक्षयिष्यामि संयुगे समुपस्थिते। असाधारणमिच्छामि तव दातुं महद्यशः॥
en: Cast off all terror of Rāma. I shall slay in battle Rāghava and Lakşmaņa and the exceedingly powerful Sugrīva and the Räksasadestroying Hanumān, who made Lankā blaze. I shall cat up the monkeys present in the encounter. And signal is the celebrity that I shall confer on you.

sa: एष वोऽभिहितो मार्गो मया वै मुनिसत्तमाः। तं दृष्ट्वा सर्वशो देवं दृष्टाः स्युः सुरसत्तमाः॥
en: O foremost of ascetics, this is the path that I show to you. By seeing Him, you will have scon all the foremost of celestials.

sa: भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च धर्मोऽर्थः काम एव च। प्राणापानावुदाश्चाप्येत एव त्रयो गुणाः॥
en: The Past, the Present, and the future, Religion, Profit and Pleasure, Prana, Apana, and Udana, these also are permeated by the three qualities.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स राजा सुमहातेजा वृद्धः कुरुकुलोद्वहः॥ न ददर्श तदा किंचिदप्रियं पाण्डुनन्दने।
en: Vishampayana said Endued with great energy, that perpetuator of Kuru's race, viz., the old king Dhritarashtra, could not see any ill-will in Yudhishthira.

sa: अमृतं मनसः प्रीतिं सद्यस्तृप्तिं ददाति च। मनो ग्लपयते तीव्र विषं गन्धेन सर्वशः॥
en: That is Ambrosia which gives immediate pleasure and joy to the mind. That is Poison which tortures the mind greatly by its smell.

sa: अनार्तो व्याधिरहितो गच्छेदनशनं तु यः। पदे पदे यज्ञफलं स प्राप्नोति न संशयः॥
en: That man who, unafflicted by discase and free from every malady, observes a fast, indeed acquires, at every step the merits of Sacrifices.

sa: तेजसा तस्य देवस्य गङ्गा विह्वलचेतना। संतापमगमत् तीव्र सोढुं सा न शशाक ह॥
en: With the energy of that god, Ganga became greatly moved at heart. Indeed, she suffered great distress and became unable to bear it.

sa: भीष्म उवाच चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य कर्माणि चातुर्वण्र्यं च केवलम्। असृजत् स हि यज्ञार्थे पूर्वमेव प्रजापतिः॥
en: Bhishma said In the beginning, the Lord of all creatures created the four castes and laid down their respective duties, for the sake of sacrifice.

sa: अथ येषामधर्मज्ञो राजा भवति नास्तिकः। न ते सुखं प्रबुध्यन्ति न सुखं प्रस्वपन्ति च॥
en: Those people whose king is unrighteous and atheistic in conduct and belief, can never be happy. Such people can never sleep or wake in peace.

sa: जमदग्निरुवाच स्थिरं चापि चलं चापि जाने त्वां ज्ञानचक्षुषा। अवश्यं विनयाधानं कार्यमद्य मया तव॥
en: Jamadagni said With the eye of knowledge I know you to be both moving and motionless! I shall surely read you a lesson this day.

sa: बृहस्पते मरुत्तस्य मा स्म कार्षीः कथंचन। दैवं कर्माथ पित्र्यं वा कर्तासि मम चेत् प्रियम्॥ अहं हि त्रिषु लोकेषु सुराणां च बृहस्पते। इन्द्रत्वं प्राप्तवानेको मरुत्तस्तु महीपतिः॥
en: O Brihaspati, if we wish to do what is agreeable to me, do not perform priestly offices for Marutta on behalf of the celestials or the departed Manes. I have, O Brihaspati, obtained the sovereignty of the three worlds, while Marutta is merely the king of the Earth.

sa: एनमस्योरसि त्वं च स्थापयस्व पितुः प्रभो। संजीवितं तदा पार्थं सत्वं द्रष्टासि पाण्डवम्॥
en: O powerful king, do you place this gem on the breast of your father. You shall then see the son of Pandu revive.

sa: तस्य घोराणि रूपाणि दीप्तानि च बहूनि च। लोके यान्यस्य पूज्यन्ते विप्रास्तानि विदुर्बुधाः॥
en: He has many burning and terrible forms. All those forms are adored in the world and are known to Brahmanas gifted with knowledge.

sa: करणं कर्म कर्ता च मोक्ष इत्येव भाविनि। चत्वार एते होतारो यैरिदं जगदावृतम्॥
en: The instrument, the action, the agent and liberation. These, O beautiful lady, are the four sacrificing pricsts by whom the universe is covered.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्तः स तु गान्धार्या कुन्तीमिदमभाषत। स्नेहबाष्पाकुले नेत्रे प्रमृज्य रुदतीं वचः॥
en: Vaishampayana continued : Thus addressed by Gandhari, king Yudhishthira, rubbing his eyes which were bathed in tears of affection, said these words bewailingly.

sa: व्यास उवाच आसीत् कृतयुगे तात मनुर्दण्डधरः प्रभुः। तस्य पुत्रो महाबाहुः प्रसन्धिरिति विश्रुतः॥
en: Vyasa said O child, in the golden age Manu was lord wielding the sceptre. His son was known under the name of Prasandhi.

sa: न तु मे वर्तते बुद्धिर्धने याज्येषु वा पुनः। विप्रियं तु करिष्यामि भ्रातुश्चेन्द्रस्य चोभयोः॥
en: For myself, I have no wish to hoard riches or sacrificial presents; I shall only do what is disagrecable to both Indra and my brother.

sa: गमयिष्यामि शक्रेण समतामपि ते ध्रुवम्। प्रियं च ते करिष्यामि सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: I shall certainly make you attain equality with Shakra, and I tell you truly that I shall do what is agreeable to you.

sa: बायोर्वा सदृशं किंचिदि ब्रूहि त्वं ब्राह्मणोत्तमम्। अपां वै सदृशं वह्नः सूर्यस्य नभसोऽपि वा॥
en: Tell does a superior Brahmana resemble the Wind in any respect? Or, is he like Water, or Fire, or the Sun, or the Firmament? inc,

sa: अमृतं च सुधा चैव स्वाहा चैव स्वधा तथा॥ अन्नौषध्यो महाराज वीरुधश्च जलोद्भवाः।
en: Ambrosia and Suddha and Svadha and milk, as also every sort of food, the deciduous herbs, O king, and creepers originate from water.

sa: आनीय च तथा वीरं राजानं बभ्रुवाहनम्। प्रदाय विपुलं वित्तं गृहान् प्रास्थापयत् तदा॥
en: Summoning next the heroic king Babhruvahana, Yudhishthira, gave to him various kinds of wealth in profusion and gave him permission to return home.

sa: शरणागतं न त्यजेयमिति मे व्रतमाहितम्। न मुञ्चति ममाङ्गानि द्विजोऽयं पश्य वै द्विज॥
en: Never to leave one who has sought my protection is my firm vow. See, O bird, this bird does not leave my lap!

sa: यश्चैव धर्मं कुरुते तस्य धर्मफलं च यत्। सर्वस्यैवांशभाग् दाता तं निमित्तं प्रवृत्तयः॥
en: When a man performs any meritorious act, assisted by what he has got in gift from another, he acquires portion of that merit.

sa: भुक्त्वा तानपि सक्तूत् स नैव तुष्टो बभूव ह। उच्छवृत्तिस्तु धर्मात्मा व्रीडामनुजगाम ह॥
en: Having eaten that barley also, the guest's hunger was not satisfied. The righteous-should host in the observance of the Unchcha vow became asharmed.

sa: पापं चापि तथैव स्यात् पापेन मनसा कृतम्। पुरोधाय मनो हीदं कर्मण्यात्मा प्रवर्तते॥
en: Similarly, sin, committed with a sinful heart, produces a large quantity of misery. The Individual Soul, placing the mind a head, performs action.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच भूनानामथ पञ्चानां यथैषामीश्वरं मनः। नियमे च विसर्गे च भूतात्मा मन एव च॥
en: Since the mind is the ruler of these five elements, for controlling and bringing them forth, the mind, therefore, is the soul of the elements.

sa: जीवः कथं वहति च चेष्टमान: कलेवरम्। किं वर्ण कीदृशं चैव निवेशयति वै पुनः॥
en: How does the Individual Soul, exerting himself, bear the body? Of what colour and of what kind is the body n which he lives again?

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तः स वसिष्ठेन जामदग्न्यः प्रतापवान्। ददौ सुवर्णे विप्रेभ्यो व्यमुच्यत च किल्बिषात्॥१६६
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by Vashishtha, Jamadagni's son of great power then made gifts of gold to the Brahmanas and became cleansed of his sins.

sa: इमं धर्मं समास्थाय येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः। स्त्रियो वैशयास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम्।।
en: By following this religion, even they who are of sinful birth, such as women and Vaishyas and Shudras, come by the highest goal.

sa: यदि त्वं प्रीतिमान् विप्र मयि वै भृगुनन्दन॥ अस्ति मे संशयः कश्चित् तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: If, O learned Brahmana, you have been pleased with me, O delighter of Bhrigu, then do you remove some doubts which are in my mind.

sa: स्वच्छन्दतस्तव सुतो गतः स्वर्गं शुभानने॥ न शक्ता विनिहन्तुं हि रणे तं सर्वदेवताः।
en: (you of beautiful face, your son has happily gone to to Heaven. All the gods assembled together could not kill him in battle.

sa: कथंवीर्यः समभवत् स राजा वदतां वर। कथं च जातरूपेण समयुज्यत स द्विज॥
en: Yudhishthira said O best of speakers, how that king waxed so powerful? And how, O twice-born one, did he get so much gold?

sa: तेषु मर्मसु भिन्नेषु ततः स समुदीरयन्। आविश्य हृदयं जन्तोः सत्त्वं चाशु रुणद्धि वै॥
en: When those vital parts are cut, the Individual Soul, rising up, enters the heat of the living creature and restrains the principle of animation forthwith.

sa: यो भर्ता वासितातुष्टो भर्तुस्तुष्टा च वासिता। यस्मिन्नेवं कुले सर्वे कल्याणं तत्र वर्तते॥
en: That house in which the husband is pleased with his married wife, and the wife pleased with her husband, all auspicious results ensue.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच ब्राह्मणानर्चसे राजन् सततं संशितव्रतान्। कं तु कर्मोदयं दृष्ट्वा तानर्चसि जनाधिप॥
en: Yudhishthira said You always worship, O king, Brahmanas of praiseworthy vows. What, however, is that fruit sceing which you adore them, O king?

sa: अर्जुन उवाच जीवाम्यहं ब्राह्मणार्थं सर्वथा सततं प्रभो। ब्रह्मण्यो ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च प्रणमामि च नित्यशः॥
en: Arjuna said O powerful god, always and by all means do I live for the Brahmanas. Devoted to them, I adore them always.

sa: अतीत्य सुरलोकं च गवां लोकं च भारत। ऋषिलोकं च सोऽगच्छद् भगीरथ इति श्रुतम्॥
en: We have heard, O Bharata, that Bhagiratha attained to that region which is superior to that of the celestials of kine, and of the Rishis.

sa: देवशर्मन् उवाच बहुमायः स विप्रर्षे भगवान् पाकशासनः। तांस्तान् विकुरुते भावान् बहूनथ मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: Devasharman said The powerful chastiser of Paka, . regenerate Rishi, is full of illusion. Every moment he assumes those forms that he chooses.

sa: एवमेतासु रक्षा वै शक्या कर्तुं महात्मभिः। अन्यथा राजशार्दूल न शक्या रक्षितुं स्त्रियः॥
en: It is thus that great persons are capable of protecting women. They cannot, O foremost of kings, be protected in any other way.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच इत्युक्तः स तदा शिष्यो गुरुणा धर्ममुत्तमम्। चकार सर्वं कौन्तेय ततो मोक्षमवाप्तवान्॥
en: Thus instructed in the principles of high religion by the preceptor, the pupil. O son of Kunti, did everything accordingly and then attained to Liberation.

sa: तत्र यत्प्राप्तकालं नस्तद् ब्रूहि वदतां वर। भवांश्चापि यथा ब्रूयात् तत्कर्तास्मि न संशयः॥
en: O foremost of all speakers, tell us what should be done under the circumstances. Forsooth, I shall do what you will advise. man

sa: सिद्ध उवाच विविधैः कर्मभिस्तात पुण्ययोगैश्च केवलैः। गच्छन्तीह गतिं मर्त्या देवलोके च संस्थितिम्॥
en: By various deeds, O son as also by the help of merit, mortal, creatures attain to diverse ends here and residence in Heaven.

sa: शुनः सखा च हत्वा तां यातुधानी महाबलाम्। भुवि त्रिदण्डं विष्टभ्य शाद्वले समुपाविशत्॥
en: Having thus killed the powerful Rakshasi, Shunasakha thrust his stick into the earth and sat himself down on a grassy plot of land.

sa: बायोर्वा सदृशं किंचिदि ब्रूहि त्वं ब्राह्मणोत्तमम्। अपां वै सदृशं वह्नः सूर्यस्य नभसोऽपि वा॥
en: Tell does a superior Brahmana resemble the Wind in any respect? Or, is he like Water, or Fire, or the Sun, or the Firmament? inc,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा कुरुन् सर्वान् भीष्मः शान्तनवस्तदा। तूष्णीं बभूव कौरव्यः स मुहूर्तमरिंदम॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said so to all the Kurus, Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, remained silent for some time, O chastiscr of enemies.

sa: स्वर्गतोऽपि पिता वृद्धस्तथा माता चिरं तव। बान्धवा भूतपूर्वाश्च तत्र वासे तु का रतिः॥
en: Your father is dead, your old mother died long ago. Your friends and relatives are also dead, why do you (then) desire to live here?

sa: इति संप्रविचार्य राजसिंहः श्वोभूते शपथस्य निश्चयम्। विससर्ज मुनीनृपांश्च सर्वान् स महात्मा महतो महानुभावः॥
en: And having made arrangements that Sītā would go through the trial next day, the highminded, generous king Rama bade adieu to all kings and Rşis.

sa: ययातिरुवाच सरिदानी गन्तव्यं सह स्वर्गजितो वयम्। एष नो विरजाः पन्था दृश्यते देवसद्मनः॥
en: Yayati said: We can now all go together. All of us have conquered heaven . Behold, the glorious path to heaven becomes visible.

sa: सुहोत्रः खल्विक्ष्वाकुकन्यामुपयेमे सुवर्णां नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे हस्ती; य इदं हास्तिनपुरं ख्यापयामास। एतदस्य हास्तिनपुरत्वम्॥
en: Suhotra married Suvarna, the daughter of Ikshaku and she gave birth to a son, named Hasti, who founded this city, called after his name Hastinapur.

sa: ययातिरुवाच अनो त्वं प्रतिपद्यस्व पाप्मानं जरया सह। एकं वर्षसहस्रं तु चरेयं यौवनेन ते॥
en: Yayati said: O Anu, take my decrepitude and its consequent weakness. I shall enjoy the pleasures of life for one thousand years with your youth.

sa: यथा हि ते मया प्राणा: संगृहीता नरेश्वर। दर्शनादेव भूयस्त्वं तथा प्राणान् ममाहरः॥
en: O king, you say that your heart has been robbed by me; but you too have robbed my heart at the first sight.

sa: नामतो धर्मपत्न्यस्ताः कीर्त्यमाना निबोध मे। कीर्तिर्लक्ष्मीधृतिर्मेधा पुष्टि श्रद्धा क्रिया तथा॥ कालस्य नयने
en: Hear, O king, the names of the wives of Dharma as I mention them. (They were) Kirti, Lakshmi, Dhriti, Medha, Pushti, Shraddha, Kriya.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्ते नरशार्दूला भ्रातरः पञ्च पाण्डवाः। प्रययुर्दोपदी द्रष्टुं तं च देशं महोत्सवम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Then those best men, the five Pandava brothers, set out out to see Draupadi, the (Panchala) country and the festivities (of Svaimvara.)

sa: भीमसेन उवाच सुखसुप्तान् वने भ्रातृन् मातरं चैव राक्षसि। न भयाद् बोधयिष्यामि भ्रातुस्तव दुरात्मनः॥
en: Bhima said: O Rakshasi, for the fear of your wicked minded brother, I shall not awaken my mother and brothers, sleeping comfortably in the forest.

sa: दृष्ट्वा च त्वां धिष्ठितं देवमार्गे शक्रार्कविष्णुप्रतिमप्रभावम्। अभ्युद्गतास्त्वां वयमद्य सर्वे तत्त्वं प्रपाते तव जिज्ञासमानाः॥
en: Seeing you in the path of the celestials, as effulgent as Surya, Indra or Vishnu, we have all come to you to ascertain the truth.

sa: पुरा नाम्ना हि दुर्वासा अत्रेः पुत्रो महामुनिः। वसिष्ठस्याश्रमे पुण्ये वार्षिक्यं समुवास ह॥
en: In the days of yore the great ascetic Durbāsā, the son of Atri, resided for a year in the holy hermitage of Vasiştha.

sa: अहं किल कुले जात इक्ष्वाकूणां महात्मनाम्। सीतापि सत्कुले जाता जनकानां महात्मनाम्॥ जानासि त्वं यथा सौम्य दण्डके विजने वने। रावणेन हृता सीता स च विध्वंसितो मया॥
en: I have been born in the illustrious family by the high-souled Ikşvākus. Sītā has been born also in the holy family of the great Janaka; gentle Lakṣmaṇa, you know how in the solitary forest of Dandaka, Sītā was stolen away by Rāvana and how have I slain him.

sa: स मे तत्र सखा चासीदुपकारी प्रियश्च मे। तेनाहं सह संगम्य वर्तयन् सुचिरं प्रभो॥
en: There he became my friend and he always sought my welfare. He was beloved to me. O lord, he lived with me for many years.

sa: सौतिरुवाच ततः स विप्रो निष्क्रान्तो निषादीसहितस्तदा। वर्धयित्वा च गरुडमिष्टं देशं जगाम ह॥
en: Sauti said: Thereupon the Brahmana came out with the Nishada woman and eulogising Garuda went to the country where he desired to go.

sa: अष्टक उवाच मुताहोस्वित् स्वेन कायेन याति। माचक्ष्व मे संशयात् प्रब्रवीमि॥ शरीरभेदाभिसमुच्छ्रयं च चक्षुःश्रोत्रे लभते केन संज्ञाम्। एतत् तत्त्वं सर्वमाचक्ष्व पृष्टः क्षेत्रज्ञं त्वां तात मन्याम सर्वे॥
en: Ashtaka said: Does a being who has got a human form enter the womb in its own shape or in some other? How does it acquire its distinct and visible shape, its eyes, ears and consciousness? Tell me all this, I ask you, because I have my doubts.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच विदुरस्य सुहृत् कश्चित् खनकः कुशलो नरः। विविक्ते पाण्डवान् राजन्निदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king, a friend of Vidura, a person wellskilled in mining, came and spoke thus to the Pandavas in private.

sa: कथितं ते मया सर्वं यथा शप्तः स पार्थिवः। शक्तिना भरतश्रेष्ठ वासिष्ठेन महात्मना॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, I have told you how the king Kalmashapada was cursed by Shakti, the illustrious son of Vasishtha.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच दुहिता वसुदेवस्य वासुदेवस्य च स्वसा। रूपेण चैष सम्पन्ना कमिवैषा न मोहयेत्॥
en: Arjuna said : She is the daughter of Vasudeva and the sister of Vasudeva (Krishna); endued with so much beauty, whom can she not fascinate?

sa: अग्ने मा त्वं प्रवर्धिष्ठाः कच्चिन्नो न दिधक्षसि। असौ हि राशिः सुमहान्समिद्धस्तव सर्पति॥
en: “O Agni, do not extend your body. Have you resolved to consume us? Lo, the huge heap of your flames is spreading wide!"

sa: तयोः समभवद् उद्विग्ने सह सम्मन्त्र्य ते भगिन्यौ तदाबले। सजीवे प्राणिशकले तत्यजाते सुदुःखिते॥
en: The helpless sisters then a great anxiety consulted with each other, and they abandoned in sorrow the fragments that had life in them.

sa: ततो नाम स कन्याया: पप्रच्छ भृगुनन्दन। वासुकि भरणं चास्या न कुर्यामित्युवाच ह॥
en: O descendant of Bhrigu, he then asked Vasuki the name of the maiden and he told him also, “I shall not maintain her."

sa: तस्य तन्न प्रियं राज्ञः शान्तनोरभवत् तदा। न च तां किंचनोवाच त्यागाद् भीतो महीपतिः॥
en: The king Shantanu could not be pleased with such conduct, but he did not speak a word to her for the fear of losing her.

sa: कण्व उवाच एवमुक्तस्तया शक्रः संदिदेश सदागतिम्। प्रातिष्ठत तदा काले मेनका वायुना सह॥
en: Kanva said: Having been thus addressed, Indra commanded the wind to be present with Menaka when she would be present before the Rishi.

sa: अनया पितृभक्त्या च विक्रमेण तव प्रभो। वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते यमिच्छसि महाद्युते॥
en: With your filial piety and prowess. O mighty one, blessing be upon you. O illustrious one. Ask the boon you desire to have.

sa: स रामस्य धनुर्वेदं दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि चैव ह। श्रुत्वा तेषु मनश्चक्रे नीतिशास्त्रे तथैव च॥
en: Having heard of Parashurama's knowledge of arms and of his celestial weapons and of his morality, he (Drona) set his heart upon them.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच यस्मादभोज्यमन्ने मे ददाति स नृपाधमः। तस्मात् तस्यैव मूढस्य भविष्यत्यत्र लोलुपा॥
en: The Brahmana said : Because that worst of kings offers me unworthy food, therefore that fool himself will be fond of such food.

sa: न दारान्वै करिष्येहमिति मे भावितं मनः। एवं दृष्ट्वा तु भवतः शकुन्तानिव लम्बतः॥
en: My mind is possessed with the idea that I must not take a wife. But having seen you, my sires, hanging like birds.

sa: इतः प्रदाने देवाश्च पितरश्चेति न श्रुतम्। त्वया दत्तेन तोयेन भविष्यन्ति हिताय वै॥
en: We have heard that if after bestowing your daughter, you offer obtains to the celestial and forefathers, they will be propitious to you.

sa: अतीतकाले दुर्भिक्षे अभ्येत्य पुनराश्रमम्। मुनिः पारेति नद्या वै नाम चक्रे तदा प्रभुः॥
en: O Lord, this illustrious man, after the famine was over, came back to his hermitage and gave the river the name of Para,

sa: निगीर्य च। अश्वसेनोऽभवत् तत्र तक्षकस्य सुतो बली। स यत्नमकरोत् तीव्र मोक्षार्थं जातवेदसः॥
en: But the powerful son of Takshaka, named Ashvasena, was there (in the forest); and he made great efforts to escape from the fire.

sa: न शोच्यः पाण्डुरनधः प्रशस्यः स नराधिपः। यस्य पञ्च सुता वीरा जाता: सुरसुतोपमाः॥
en: Do not lament for the sinless Pandu; he was a worthy king and has left behind him five sons like the celestial children.

sa: मम हि त्वद्विहीनायाः सर्वप्राणधनेश्वर। कथं स्यातां सुतौ बालौ भरेयं च कथं त्वहम्॥
en: You are my life, wealth and lord; having been abandoned by you, how these children to tender years and how myself, can live?

sa: जरत्कारुरुवाच मम पूर्वे भवन्तो वै पितरः सपितामहाः। तद्भूत यन्मया कार्यं भवतां प्रियकाम्यया॥
en: Jaratkaru said : You are my fathers and grandfathers who are gone before. Tell me, therefore, what I can do for your welfare.

sa: इयं च मे सखी दासी यत्राहं तत्र गामिनी। दुहिता दानवेन्द्रस्य शर्मिष्ठा वृषपर्वणः॥
en: This my companion is my maid, she will go wherever I shall go. She is Sharmishtha, the daughter of the Asura king, Vrishaparva.

sa: ययातिरुवाच दुह्यो त्वं प्रतिपद्यस्व वर्णरूपविनाशिनीम्। जरां वर्षसहस्रं मे यौवनं स्वं ददस्व च॥
en: Yayati said : O Druhyu, take upon yourself for one thousand years my decrepitude, destructive of beauty and complexion. Give me your youth.

sa: अङ्गारपर्णं गन्धर्वं वित्त मां स्वबलाश्रयम्। अहं हि मानी चेर्युश्च कुबेरस्य प्रियः सखा॥
en: This my forest on the banks of the Ganges is known by the name of Angarparna in which I sport to gratify myself.

sa: राम राम न संतापं कर्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत। स्मर त्वं पूर्वकं भावं मन्त्रं चामित्रकर्शन॥
en: O Rāma of firm vows, O slayer of enemies, you should not grieve thus, Recollect your former state of Vişņu and the counsels.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच भ्रातृभिः सह कौन्तेय निबोध गदतो मम। पुनर्वो विग्रहो मा भूत् खाण्डवप्रस्थमाविश॥
en: Dhritarashtra said: O sun of Kunti, (Yudhishthira), listen with your brothers to what I say. Go to Khandavaprastha, so that no difference may arise again.

sa: दैवं च परमं मन्ये पौरुषं चाप्यनर्थकम्। धिगस्तु पौरुषं तात ध्रियन्ते यत्र पाण्डवाः॥
en: I believe that Destiny is supreme and human exertion is useless. O brother, fie on our exertions, when the Pandavas are still alive!"

sa: जानन्नपि च यः पापं शक्तिमान् न नियच्छति। ईशः सन् सोऽपि तेनैव कर्मणा सम्प्रयुज्यते॥
en: The man who having power to punish sin, does not do so, knowing that a sin has been committed, is himself defiled by that sin.

sa: कथं शुक्रस्य नप्तारं देवयान्याः सुतं प्रभो। ज्येष्ठं यदुर तिक्रम्य राज्यं पूरोः प्रयच्छसि॥
en: “O lord, how can you install Puru on the throne, passing over your eldest son Yadu, born of Devayani and grandson of Shukra?

sa: अवाप्य दीर्घमायुस्तु यः प्राप्तो विकृतिं चरेत्। तप्यते यदि तत् कृत्वा चरेत् सोऽन्यत् तपस्ततः॥
en: Those that devote themselves to Yoga meditation take time to acquire that knowledge, for by practice alone they divest themselves from the idea of duality.

sa: पौरकार्याणि यो राजा न करोति दिने दिने। संवृते नरके घोरे पतितो नात्र संशयः॥
en: For sooth do a king falls into the dreadful bell where the wind does not blow, who does not daily look into his state affairs.

sa: यो हि कारणतः क्रोधं संजातं क्षन्तुमर्हति। नालं स मनुजः सम्यक् त्रिवर्गं परिरक्षितुम्॥
en: The men, who suppresses his anger excited by a just cause, becomes incapable of duly compassing the Three varga (Dharma, Artha and Kama.)

sa: निगृह्य तं बलाद् भीमो विस्फुरन्तं चकर्ष ह। तस्माद् देशाद् धनूंष्यष्टौ सिंहः क्षुद्रमृगं यथा॥
en: Then seizing the struggling Rakshasas with violence, Bhima dragged him away from that place full thirty two cubits, as a lion drags a small deer.

sa: प्रणत: संभ्रमादेव प्राञ्जलिः पुरतः स्थितः। सखेति सहसेदं ते नर्मार्थं वै कृतं मया॥
en: Bending low and joining both hands, "As I am your friend, I have done this only as a joke to make you laugh.

sa: द्वारिणं तापसा ऊचू राजानं च प्रकाशय। ते तु गत्वा क्षणेनैव सभायां विनिवेदिताः॥
en: The ascetics told the gate keepers "Go, inform the king.” They went in a moment to the royal court and informed the king.

sa: धर्मे प्रयतमानस्य सत्यं च वदतः समम्। पृष्टो यदब्रवं सत्यं व्यभिचारोऽत्र को मम॥
en: What transgression is committed by me, who tried to do justice and to speak the truth impartially? Being asked, I told the truth.

sa: जरत्कारुर्गतः स्वर्गं सहित: स्वैः पितामहैः। आस्तीकं च सुतं प्राप्य धर्मं चानुत्तमं मुनिः॥
en: Jaratkaru, of great austerity, attained heaven with his forefathers. Begetting the son, Astika and acquiring great religious merit, the best of the Munis,

sa: अर्जुन उवाच अस्माकमनुरूपो वै यः स्याद् गन्धर्व वेदवित्। पुरोहितस्तमाचक्ष्व सर्वं हि विदितं तव॥
en: Arjuna said : O Gandharva, you are acquainted with every thing. Tell us therefore what Vedaknowing Brahmana is fit, to be appointed as our priest?

sa: मा तात तात तातेति ब्रूह्येनं पितरं पितुः। रक्षसा भक्षितस्तात तव तातो वनान्तरे॥
en: "O child, do not address your father's father as your father. O son, your father was devoured by a Rakshasas in another forest.

sa: अतोऽन्यथा चेत् क्रियते न हितं नो भविष्यति। तवाप्यकीर्तिः सकला भविष्यति न संशयः॥
en: If you act otherwise, no good will come to any of us. There is no doubt we all will be covered with dishonour.

sa: प्रसादितो मया पूर्वं तवार्थाय पितामहः। तस्मात्तव भयं नास्ति व्येतु ते मानसो ज्वरः॥
en: The Grandfather was pacified by me for your sake. Therefore, you have no fear. Drive away this fever of fear from your mind.”

sa: स्तम्बमित्र उवाच सर्वमग्ने त्वमेवैकस्त्वयि सर्वमिदं जगत्। त्वं धारयसि भूतानि भुवनं त्वं बिभर्षि च॥
en: Stambamitra said : O Agni, you are every thing. The whole universe is established in you. You uphold every creature and you support the worlds.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः। ददानीत्येव तं दाशो धर्मात्मा प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard those words, the hair of the fisherman stood erect in delight and he said, “I bestowed my daughter."

sa: कालदण्डं यमो राजन् गदां चैव धनेश्वरः। पाशांश्च तत्र वरुणो विचित्रां च तथाशनिम्॥
en: O king, Yama took up his death dealing club, the lord of wealth (Kubera) his mace, Varuna his noose and his beautiful missiles,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तया भर्ता तां समालिङ्गय भारत। मुमोच बाष्पं शनकैः सभार्यो भृशदुःखितः॥
en: O foremost of the Bharata race, when Brahmani told thus, her husband became griefstricken and, embracing her, shed copious tears along with her.

sa: किं तत्र संविधातव्यं भवतां स्याद्धितं तु यत्। श्रेयः प्रसादनं मन्ये कश्यपस्य महात्मनः॥
en: What I suggest would be for your good! I think the favour of (our father) the illustrious Kashyapa can alone do us good.

sa: उवाच च सुसंक्रुद्धः शत्रुघ्नः स निशाचरम्। योद्धमिच्छामि दुर्बुद्धेः द्वन्द्वयुद्धं त्वया सह ॥
en: Greatly enraged he said to the night-ranger O you of a vicious intellect, I wish to enter into a dual encounter with you.

sa: संजय उवाच तद् धर्मशीलस्य वचो निशम्य राज्ञः क्रुद्धस्यातिरथो महात्मा। उवाच दुर्धर्षमदीनसत्त्वं युधिष्ठिरं जिष्णुरनन्तवीर्यः॥
en: Sanjaya said Hearing those words of the pious kirg, who was all anger, the great warrior Jishnu of indomitable energy said to the irrepressible and

sa: अभिसृत्य च मां युद्धे परुषाण्युक्तवान् बहु। तत्र तत्र युधां श्रेष्ठ परिभूय न संशयः॥
en: Forsooth pursuing me on all the sides and defeating all my allies in that battle that foremost of warriors addressed to me many harsh words.

sa: ते वध्यमाना द्रोणेन पाण्डुपुत्रस्य सैनिकाः। प्राद्रवन् वै भयाद् राजन् सार्तनादा दिशो दश॥
en: (Thus) struck by Drona, the troops of the son of Pandu with loud wails fled away in terror in ten directions, O king.

sa: नाहं भीषयितुं शक्यो वाङ्मात्रेण तु केवलम्। स मां निहन्यात् संग्रामे यो मां कुर्यान्निरायुधम्॥
en: I am not to be terrified by empty words. He will slay me in battle who will be competent to deprive me of my weapons.

sa: न्यास्यायुधं रणे विप्र द्रोण मा त्वं चिरं कृथाः। मा पापिष्ठतरं कर्म करिष्यसि पुनर्द्विज॥
en: O Drona, quickly lay you weapons aside in this battle; do not hesitate O twice-born one, you should not perpetrate such sinful acts any longer.

sa: जाम्बूनदेष्वाभरणेषु चैव निष्केषु शुद्धेषु शरासनेषु। पीतेषु शस्त्रेषु च पावकस्य प्रतिप्रभास्तत्र तदा बभूवुः॥
en: The lustre of the lamps (falling upon the golden Ornaments) the bright cuirasses and bow and the will-tempered weapons, was reflected from them.

sa: इति ते कत्थमानस्य श्रुतं संसदि संसदि॥ अनुतिष्ठ प्रतिज्ञा तां सत्यवाग् भव तैः सह।
en: This brag of yours was heard in every assemblage of the court. Now with their help fulfill your vow and be true to your words.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वार्जुन एकवीरः क्षिप्रं रिपुनः क्षतजोपमाक्षः। भीमं मुमुक्षः समरे प्रयातः कर्णस्य कायाच शिरो जिहीर्घः॥
en: Saying this much to Achyuta that hero of heroes and destroyer of enemies, rushed to battle with a view to rescue Bhima and dissever Karna.

sa: संजय उवाच रथमन्यं समास्थाय विधिवत् कल्पितं पुनः। अभ्ययात् पाण्डवं कर्णो वातोद्भूत इवार्णवः॥
en: Sanjaya said Riding on another duly furnished car, Karna then rushed at Pandu's son, like the ocean lashed into fury by the tempest.

sa: अथैनं पञ्चविंशत्या सायकानां समार्पयत्। अवप्लुत्य रथाच्चैद्यो गदामादाय सत्वरः॥ भारद्वाजाय चिक्षेप रुषितामिव पन्नगीम्।
en: He then pierced Dhristaketu himself with twenty five arrows. The prince of the Chedis then leaping off from his chariot, grasped a mace.

sa: संजय उवाच एवं ब्रुवाणं कण तु कृपः शारद्वतोऽब्रवीत्। स्मयन्निव महाबाहुः सूतपुत्रमिदं वचः॥
en: Sanjaya said When Karna was saying all this the mightyarmed Kripa, the son of Saradvata smilingly said these words to the charioteer's son.

sa: चक्षुर्मनोभ्यां संतोष्या विप्राः पूज्याश्च शक्तितः। न चैषां विप्रियं कार्यं ते हि वह्निशिखोपमाः॥
en: You should always propitiate the Brahmanas with presents and worship. Never do anything that will offend them; for, they are flames of fire.

sa: आत्मानं च कृतात्मानं समीक्ष्य भरतर्षभ। कृतागसं च राधेयं धर्मात्मनि युधिष्ठिरे। प्रतिपद्यस्व कौन्तेयं प्राप्तकालमनन्तरम्॥
en: O foremost of Bharatas, knowing yourself self-controlled and Karna cherishing animosity against the pious Yudhishthira, O son of Kunti, make use of this good opportunity.

sa: सूतपुत्रेण नागेषु हयेषु त रथेषु च॥ नरेषु च महाराज कृतं स्म कदनं महत्।
en: Suta's son, O most valiant of men, indeed made a havoc amongst the elephants and horses and destroyed the cars and men in countless numbers.

sa: यावद् गाण्डीवघोषं त्वं न शृणोषि महाहवे। तावदेव त्वया कर्ण शक्यं वक्तुं यथेच्छसि॥
en: As long as you do not hear the twang of Gandiva in battle, so long you are able to do what you please.

sa: संजय उवाच तमुद्यतं तु वेगेन राजा दुर्योधनः स्वयम्। न्यवारयन्महातेजाः कृपश्च द्विपदां वरः॥
en: Sanjaya said The highly-energetic king Duryodhana himself and that best of men, Kripa, prevented him (i.e., Ashvatthama) who was rushing furiously (at Karna).

sa: गदाश्च शैक्याः परिघाश्च शुभ्रा रथेषु शक्त्यश्च विवर्तमानाः। प्रतिप्रभारश्मिभिराजमीढ पुनः पुनः संजनयन्ति दीपान्॥
en: The rays (of these lamps) falling upon maces entwined with strings, bright Parighas, cars and darts as they whirled along, created innumerable lamps.

sa: जीवन् प्राप्नोति पुरुषः संख्ये जयपराजयौ। मृतस्य तु हृषीकेश भङ्ग एव कुतो जयः॥
en: If a man survives he either meets with success or defeat in battle. To one dead, O Hrishikesh, death itself is a victory.

sa: यथैव मत्तो मद्येन त्वं तथा लक्ष्यसे वृष। तथाऽद्य त्वां प्रमाद्यन्तं चिकित्सेयं सुहत्तया॥
en: O Vrisha, you appear like an intoxicated man. For all that, out of friendship I will try to cure you of your mistakes.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच स्वागतं देवकीमातः स्वागतं ते धनंजय। प्रियं मे दर्शनं गाढं युवयोरच्युतार्जुनौ॥
en: Yudhishthira said Welcome to you, Devaki's son and Dhananjaya, highly agreeable to me is the pleasure of you too, O Arjuna, O Achyuta.
